nodes.description: Surgery is reserved for failed medical therapy and complications: thoracotomy repair of a perforation or esophagopleural fistula, repair or resection for persistent tracheoesophageal or bronchoesophageal fistula, and emergency endovascular aortic repair followed by esophageal reconstruction for an aortoesophageal fistula. Video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery has been used to obtain a diagnosis. Every effort should be made to diagnose the disease without surgery, because it is medically curable and esophagectomy for presumed carcinoma is avoidable.
